rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for speaking aloud to oneself or performing a soliloquy.

example.english: They soliloquize on stage, pouring out all their feelings.
example.traditional: 佢喺台上自言自語，將心事一股腦講晒出嚟。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 toi4 soeng6 zi6 jin4 zi6 jyu5 zoeng1 sam1 si6 jat1 gu2 nou5 gong2 saai3 ceot1 lai4

rows.note: Use this for an unspoken thought rather than words said aloud.

example.english: I soliloquize silently on the bus that today is really unlucky.
example.traditional: 我一路搭車，一路心諗今日真係黑仔。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 lou6 daap3 ce1 jat1 lou6 sam1 nam2 gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 hak1 zai2
